issue.title: Clarify Record-tab messaging when source text is missing after sync
issue.body:
## Summary / context

On Record, any missing local `bible_texts` row (`bibleTextId === null`) currently shows:

> Source text still syncing for this verse — recording will unlock when ready.

That copy is misleading when **cloud sync has already finished** (green sync status) but verse text never landed — e.g. bible-text sync skipped / returned empty, chapter not fully assignable yet, or API has no text for that unit. Users wait forever thinking sync is still in flight.

Surfaced while QA’ing [#235](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/235) against a new BSB Mark project on Dev (`projectId` 432): assignments synced, Record opened on Mark 1, hint never cleared, dock correctly showed **No source audio** as a separate lane.

## Current vs expected

**Current:** Missing text ⇒ always “still syncing…”.

**Expected:** Distinguish **sync in progress** from **text unavailable after sync settled**.

## Scope

**In scope**
- Record-tab (and any shared hint) copy/state when `bibleTextId` is null
- Use existing sync signals already on device (e.g. sync in flight vs idle / last-synced) — no new backend
- Keep / reinforce that **source audio empty** stays its own honest dock state (`No source audio`), not conflated with text sync
- Unit tests for the message / state selection

**Out of scope**
- Explaining web-only rules (e.g. Assign disabled until ≥2 translators)
- Fixing bible-text sync gaps themselves (file separately if AC needs it)
- Source-audio fetch/playback (#235)
- Shell Bible-tab player (#412)

## Suggested messaging

| Condition | Message direction |
| --- | --- |
| Sync actively running + no local text | Keep “Source text syncing…” (or equivalent) |
| Sync idle + no local text for this verse | “Source text isn’t available for this verse yet.” + affordance to open Sync / retry |
| Text ready, source audio empty | Unchanged: dock `No source audio` |

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] When sync is in progress and text is missing, messaging still indicates syncing
- [ ] When sync is **not** in progress and text is missing, messaging does **not** claim text is “still syncing”
- [ ] User can tell the difference from source-audio-empty dock chrome
- [ ] Unit coverage for the hint/state selection
- [ ] Android smoke: open a chapter with no local `bible_texts` after a settled sync and confirm copy

## File pointers

- `src/app/tabs/RecordTab.tsx` (`syncingMessage` / `recordDisabled` when `bibleTextId === null`)
- Sync status signals: `src/utils/syncStatusState.ts`, sync hooks / Sync screen as applicable

## Related

- Follow-up from [#235](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/235) (source audio dock wiring)
- Related UX confusion with green sync chrome vs missing verse text
- Board: [Fluent Mobile Board (Project 4, view 9)](https://github.com/orgs/eten-tech-foundation/projects/4/views/9)
